item.title: RVA Freedom rally draws crowd in support of Iran war
item.description: A group gathered in downtown Richmond on Sunday to show support for the war with Iran, praising President Trump's actions following the death of Iran's Supreme Leader.

item.title: 22-year-old from New Kent among 6 injured in Virginia Beach Oceanfront shooting
item.description: Officers patrolling the Oceanfront heard gunfire around 9:50 p.m. Saturday in the 1800 block of Atlantic Avenue. When officers responded, they found five people suffering from gunshot wounds.

item.title: Multi-vehicle wreck with downed power lines closes Route 60 east in New Kent
item.description: A multi-vehicle crash that downed power lines has closed eastbound Route 60 in New Kent County Sunday night.
